Hi Sofia —

Happy Tuesday. As we get closer to renewal, Tom and I discussed a short roadmap demo + ops QBR to align on the next 12 months and finalize the Mutual Action Plan. Goal: 30–45 minutes, executive summary + live demo of the integration path we outlined.

Options we have open on our side (PST):
- Wed 11/10, 09:00–09:45
- Thu 11/11, 13:30–14:15
- Fri 11/12, 11:00–11:45

If those don't work, can you share a few windows that work for your stakeholders (engineering + procurement + legal)? I threw together an agenda and a runbook (attached) and propose we send a single calendar invite with an optional pre-read.

Attachments: Renewal-Agenda-v2.pdf, Demo-Runbook.xlsx

Thanks — look forward to locking this in.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Note: If procurement needs a separate slot for contract redlines we can schedule a 15-min sync after the demo.

Hi Chloe —

Thanks for the options. Quick note on stakeholders: our VP Product (Tom) will join but our procurement lead, Maria, is in Jakarta that week and can only join late-afternoon EST. Proposed windows (EST):
- Thu 11/11, 16:30–17:15 (would be Maria joining remotely)
- Fri 11/12, 12:00–12:45

Legal wants to see the MSA redlines in advance; I cc'd legal@celerate.com so they have context. We can do the demo + high-level roadmap and then a 15-min procurement follow-up on the same day for any outstanding items.

Tom — are you OK with the later slot on Thu?

Chloe / Steph —

Great — thanks for the heads up. If Celerate prefers Thu 11/11 16:30–17:15 EST, that's 13:30–14:15 PST which matches one of our proposed slots. Two operational asks before we lock:
1) Which integration path should we demo (quick embed vs full API)? It sounds like Tom wants product-level details; recommend we plan for the full API flow with fallback to the embed demo if time's tight.
2) Who will own the procurement follow-up? I'd suggest Steph lead the 15-min redline walkthrough (she has the contract context).

I'll prepare a short canary build demo that shows the ROI dashboard. Attaching the runbook I tweaked.

-Marcus

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for confirming the windows. I'm happy to take procurement traffic. For the MSA redlines: can your legal team share a .docx with tracked changes? That will speed the back-and-forth. I'll prepare a 15-minute procurement checklist and post the cleaned redlines to the drive before the meeting.

Proposed meeting flow (30–45 mins):
- 0:00–0:05: Quick exec recap & goals (Chloe)
- 0:05–0:20: Live roadmap + API demo (Marcus)
- 0:20–0:30: Operations & ROI metrics (Marcus)
- 0:30–0:40: Procurement quick win / next steps (Stephanie)

I can also host a short follow-up (15 mins) immediately after if Maria wants to run redlines live.

Regards,

Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com

Chloe / Marcus —

13:30 PST (Thu 11/11) works for me. Full API flow preferred — I want to see how the KV cache and batching will affect our tail-latency for batch jobs. If you can show fallback behavior to a quantized variant that's a plus.

One ask from engineering: can you record the session and drop a 20–30 sec clip of the KPI dashboard after the demo for our execs who can't make it?

I'll confirm Maria's attendance tomorrow; if she can't make Thu late, we'll take the Fri slot.

Thanks,
